title: TC-SAW (Temperature Compensated SAW) - n78 (3.3-3.8 GHz 5G NR) for IoT Narrowband Module
subtitle: Design Validation and Performance Characterization
author: Sarah Okonkwo

sections.1_OBJECTIVE: This document describes the design, simulation, and characterization of a TC-SAW (Temperature Compensated SAW) filter targeting n78 (3.3-3.8 GHz 5G NR) for IoT Narrowband Module. The filter is designed on Quartz substrate with a target center frequency of 5207.1 MHz and bandwidth of 249.2 MHz. The objective is to validate that the filter meets the required insertion loss, rejection, and linearity specifications for integration into the IoT Narrowband Module module. This design iteration addresses feedback from the previous revision regarding out-of-band rejection improvements and temperature stability.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Filter Type: TC-SAW (Temperature Compensated SAW)
- Frequency Band: n78 (3.3-3.8 GHz 5G NR)
- Application: IoT Narrowband Module
- Substrate: Quartz
- Package: SiP (System in Package)
- Design Tool: Synopsys CustomSim
- Design Center: Andover HQ Lab

This specification applies to all variants of the TC-SAW (Temperature Compensated SAW) design targeting n78 (3.3-3.8 GHz 5G NR). Results are used to qualify the design for mass production release.
sections.3_DESIGN_PARAMETERS:
Center Frequency:       5207.1 MHz
Bandwidth (3 dB):       249.2 MHz
Insertion Loss Target:  <= 2.2 dB
Return Loss Target:     >= 14.0 dB
Out-of-Band Rejection:  >= 49.0 dB
Isolation (Duplexer):   >= 24.0 dB
Q Factor:               13850
Temperature Coefficient:-11.1 ppm/°C
Die Size:               2.6 x 0.9 mm
Wafer Size:             6-inch
Number of Resonators:   7
Electrode Material:     Pt/Al
Passivation:            SiO2
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Open Synopsys CustomSim and load the TC-SAW (Temperature Compensated SAW) template project.
2. Define the substrate stack: Quartz with specified layer thicknesses.
3. Set design targets: center freq 5207.1 MHz, BW 249.2 MHz.
4. Run initial EM simulation with 2D mesh density of 20 cells/wavelength.
5. Optimize resonator geometry using gradient descent (target IL < 2.2 dB).
6. Verify coupling coefficients between resonator stages.
7. Run 3D FEM simulation to account for package parasitics (SiP (System in Package)).
8. Export GDS-II layout for mask fabrication.
9. Fabricate prototype wafers (6-inch, Quartz).
10. Perform on-wafer probing using Keysight E5080B ENA.
11. Measure S-parameters (S11, S21, S12, S22) from 100 MHz to 15621 MHz.
12. Compare measured results against simulation and specification limits.
13. Perform temperature cycling (-40°C to +85°C) and re-measure.
14. Document results and generate summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Insertion loss at center frequency shall be <= 2.2 dB
- Return loss in passband shall be >= 14.0 dB
- Out-of-band rejection at +/- 374 MHz offset >= 49.0 dB
- Group delay variation across passband shall be <= 10 ns
- Temperature drift over -40°C to +85°C shall be <= 7.2 MHz
- Power handling shall be >= +35 dBm at 1 dB compression
- ESD tolerance >= 2000 V (HBM)
- Die yield on qualification lot >= 97%
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Measurement Date:       2025-02-21
Devices Tested:         70
Insertion Loss (meas):  1.87 dB
Return Loss (meas):     16.0 dB
Rejection (meas):       51.9 dB
Isolation (meas):       28.9 dB
Q Factor (meas):        13850
Group Delay Variation:  4.6 ns
Power Handling:         +35 dBm
Die Yield:              89.8%

Result Classification:  NEEDS REVIEW
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The TC-SAW (Temperature Compensated SAW) design demonstrated below-target performance for n78 (3.3-3.8 GHz 5G NR).
b) Insertion loss met target specification.
c) Out-of-band rejection exceeded the minimum requirement.
d) Group delay flatness improved compared to previous revision.
e) ESD robustness exceeded specification by 2x margin.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS:
1. Review near-band rejection margin for worst-case temperature.
2. Re-run EM simulation with refined mesh for better accuracy.
3. Schedule follow-up measurement after design tweak.
